brief_rationale: No serious responsibility-chain errors; all RC items met with safe discharge planning and follow-up. Three high-order points (HO1, HO3, HO4) completed with meaningful trajectory impact. All dimensions good-to-excellent. Closure is safe, executable, and traceable with caregiver read-back. Grade 4 Strong.
